Hi Elena — great to hear the team is moving forward. Quick answers inline, and I'll attach our intake checklist.

- Procurement docs: we typically require a signed Marketplace Partner Agreement (we can send a redline), a W-9 (for US companies) or equivalent tax form, and a PO/commit for reserved capacity deals.
- SKU mapping/invoicing: purchases via Marketplace are billed through GCP and credited to you as the seller; for Dedicated/reserved contracts we do direct invoicing. We'll provide a SKU mapping spreadsheet and a billing handoff that shows reconciliation points.
- Security artifacts: SOC2 summary and a data flow diagram are helpful. For private deployments we'll need KMS/HSM attestations.

I've attached our RBWD-GCP-onboard-checklist.xlsx — it has the gating steps, owner (Redwood vs Seller), and estimated lead times. Proposed next step: 30-min sync with procurement + marketplace ops. Vanessa — can you take point on ops tasks and confirm available slots next week?

Best,

Elena / team — thanks for the patience. Following our sync today, here's the agreed procurement/staging gate checklist and next steps (condensed):

1) Legal & Agreement (owner: Marissa) — ETA 3 business days to provide a Marketplace Partner Agreement redline; key items to expect: revenue share language, indemnity carve-outs, and a 60-day payment term option for reserved deals. Attachment: BlueBoat-MAP-draft.pdf (for review).

2) Tax & Procurement Intake (owner: BlueBoat) — BlueBoat to provide W-9 / W-8 and PO (if committing to Reserved). ETA: 5 business days after you confirm lead.

3) SKU Mapping & Billing Handoff (owner: Jonas) — Jonas will send the SKU mapping template and a reconciliation checklist. Typical lead time: 7 business days from receipt of sample invoice.

4) Security Artifacts (owner: Vanessa) — Redwood needs SOC2 extract (redacted allowed) and a high-level data flow diagram. Vanessa will review and confirm if further evidence is required. ETA: 4 business days after submission.

5) Technical Staging & Prod Cutover (owner: Karthik) — coordinate staging access, test purchases, and one end-to-end purchase validation with BlueBoat. Suggested window: 2 weeks after SKU mapping is finalized.

Action items:
- Elena: upload SOC2-extract-2025.pdf, W-9, and the PO draft to the shared Drive link by EOD Thu (9/10).
- Jonas: share SKU mapping template and sample reconciliation matrix (due 9/15).
- Marissa: send Marketplace Partner Agreement redline and track legal comments (due 9/10).
- Vanessa: confirm any additional security evidence required after SOC2 review (due 9/14).

I'll also create a DocuSign envelope for the MAP and send a link once the redline is accepted. Link: https://docusign.com/envelope/XYZ-BlueBoat (placeholder).

Elena — happy to jump back on a 20-min call if anything above needs clarification.
